title: How we describe the need for Slack
slide_intent: Teach writers to explain a product from the audience’s difficulty through to the proposed outcome. The sequence makes the benefit easier to follow.
strategic_value: Slack can give communicators a repeatable account of coordination problems and its proposed role in solving them.
demonstration: Three stacked text blocks separate the coordination challenge, Slack’s proposed solution and the result claimed in its messaging.
practical_value: Use the three headings to check whether a product introduction gives the reader a problem, a response and a reason to care.
